scope: IOAPIC ID/Version/Arbitration ID registers, 24-entry redirection window, atomic refusal of unknown selects and invalid vector/delivery/destination writes, consistency with the firmware MADT (ID 1, 24 inputs)

registers.id: 0x00: reset 0x01000000, bits 27:24 RW, reserved bits refused

decisions.unknown_select: IOREGSEL stores any byte; IOWIN read/write on unknown select -> UnknownOffset, no state change
decisions.invalid_writes: UnsupportedConfiguration, no state change (vector < 16 or 0xFF unmasked, any non-Fixed delivery mode, logical destination, polarity except masked active-low on pins without a line, reserved bits, nonzero high dword)
decisions.masked_vector: masked entries accept any vector byte (reset is masked with vector 0)

checks.io_apic: cargo test -p od-machine --lib io_apic --offline -- --test-threads=1: 19 passed (11 old + 8 new)
checks.full_od_machine: cargo test -p od-machine --offline -- --test-threads=4: 634 passed, 0 failed (before review fixes, which added 2 tests)

changed_old_expectations: io_apic::tests::reset_registers_and_rejected_accesses_are_atomic: selector 1 (was unknown, now Version) replaced by 3; IOREGSEL readback 1 -> 3
limitations: logical destination, lowest priority and other delivery modes are refused, not routed
entries other than INTIN4 store configuration only and have no input line
ID RW/Arbitration RO and register layout are from accepted S4-26a/b policy and are not re-verified against the datasheet text
SCI GSI 9 level/active-low is accepted only masked; unmasking is refused (risk for S4-29/S4-38)
no IOAPIC EOI register (0x40); register 0x03 is UnknownOffset; Version 0x20 as ICH/QEMU-style
polarity from S4-26 is covered only for active-high on INTIN4 and masked entries without a line; close parent S4-26 with this caveat
